headline: MEXICO PERMITS AXO'S 1.1 Moz GOLD PROJECT IN SONORA — EXISTING 4,000 tpd MILL CLEARED FOR PRODUCTION; PEA DUE Q3 2026 (TSXV: AXO)
snippet: Axo Metals Corp. (TSXV: AXO) received a positive decision from Mexico's federal environmental agency SEMARNAT on July 27 approving the Environmental Impact Statement for the San Antonio Gold Project in Sonora — the key regulatory hurdle separating the company from production at a site that hosts 1.1 million ounces across five deposits with an existing 4,000-tonne-per-day processing mill on site. P&E Mining Consultants is completing a preliminary economic assessment targeted for late Q3 2026, with a routine land-use change approval the only remaining administrative step before mining can begin at the main Sapuchi, Golfo de Oro, and California deposits.

headline: EQUINOX-ORLA $18.5B MERGER COURT ORDER TOMORROW — NORTH AMERICA'S NEW 1.1M oz GOLD GIANT CLOSING JULY 31 (TSX: EQX)
snippet: Equinox Gold and Orla Mining shareholders overwhelmingly approved their $18.5 billion business combination on July 22, with the Supreme Court of British Columbia expected to issue a final court order July 28 and the deal set to close July 31, 2026. The combined company will produce 1.1 million ounces of gold annually from a portfolio spanning the Greenstone, Valentine, and Musselwhite mines, with a stated growth path to 1.9 million ounces and 23 million ounces of mineral reserves — making it Canada's second-largest gold producer at a moment when the senior gold sector is trading at historically wide discounts to NAV.

headline: JAPAN CONFIRMS 54% MEDIUM-HEAVY RARE EARTH IN PACIFIC SEABED — 16 Mt DEPOSIT AT 6KM DEPTH COULD COVER GLOBAL DEMAND FOR DECADES
snippet: Japan's government confirmed July 25 that mud recovered from 6-kilometre depths near Minamitori Island in the Pacific — the world's first continuous recovery of seabed rare earth-bearing mud — contained medium and heavy rare earth elements at 54% of total REE content, including dysprosium, terbium, and europium. The Minami Torishima deposit holds an estimated 16-plus million tonnes of material that could theoretically supply current global rare earth consumption for decades, with full-scale commercial trials planned for 2027 and a production decision targeted for 2027-2028 — a direct strategic counter to China's export restriction campaign.

headline: TRAILBREAKER MOVES DRILL TO SWAN ZONE Cu-Au PORPHYRY — 2.1 KM CHARGEABILITY ANOMALY TARGETED AT ATSUTLA, BC (TSXV: TBK)
snippet: Trailbreaker Resources Ltd. (TSXV: TBK) completed its maiden drill program at the Highlands Zone and mobilized the drill 26 kilometres to the Swan Zone at its 300 km² Atsutla Gold Project in northwestern British Columbia, commencing the first-ever drill test of a 1.5 km × 1.5 km multi-element soil geochemical anomaly coincident with a 2.1 km × 1.4 km IP chargeability anomaly — the hallmark of a buried Cu-Au porphyry system hosted in the Cretaceous Glundebery batholith. A third porphyry target at the company's Coho property, located 30 km northwest of the producing Mt. Milligan mine, is scheduled for September 2026.

headline: ROKMASTER OPTIONS 9 KM² UNDRILLED PORPHYRY NEAR COLLAHUASI — BURIED Cu TARGET AT 600-800m IN CHILE'S NORTH (TSXV: RKR)
snippet: Rokmaster Resources Corp. (TSXV: RKR) announced July 27 it has entered an option agreement for the Cristal Property — three exploitation concessions covering approximately 9 km² along the West Fissure north of the Collahuasi/Ujina porphyry copper district in northern Chile — for consideration of 21 million Rokmaster shares over 36 months plus US$70,000 cash. Historical magnetic and gravity surveys indicate a large concealed porphyry copper system at 600-800 metres depth that has never been drilled, adjacent to one of the world's largest operating copper mines.

headline: RENFORTH EXTENDS VICTORIA Ni/Cu/Co DOWN DIP IN ALL 3 HOLES — MINERALIZATION GROWS OUTSIDE EXISTING RESOURCE BOUNDARY (CSE: RFR)
snippet: Renforth Resources (CSE: RFR) completed its undercut drill program at the Victoria Ni/Cu/Co Open Pit Polymetallic Deposit in Quebec on July 27, with all three holes returning visual nickel-copper-cobalt mineralization as down-dip continuations beyond the current Mineral Resource Estimate boundary. The program tested two locations outside and below the existing resource, demonstrating the deposit remains open at depth; assay results are pending. The Victoria deposit represents Renforth's primary development asset in the Abitibi region.

headline: GOLD SPECS HOLD 124,831 NET LONGS AS SILVER RATIO COMPRESSES TO 69.5 — COT DATA SHOWS CLEAN SETUP HEADING INTO FED WEEK
snippet: The July 24 Commitments of Traders report covering positions as of July 21 shows managed money holding 124,831 net long COMEX gold contracts and 11,282 net long silver contracts, with silver up 2% on the week as the gold-silver ratio compressed to 69.5. The COT data is notable for what it does NOT show: speculative positioning remains historically lean relative to the gold price level, meaning the speculative overhang that typically caps precious metals rallies has not been rebuilt since the April correction — a setup that can produce disproportionate price moves when a macro catalyst re-attracts the speculative herd.

headline: CANADA NICKEL'S 9th TIMMINS RESOURCE: NESBITT 176 Mt AT 0.23% Ni + DELORO UP 46% — DISTRICT NOW 4.63 BILLION TONNES (TSXV: CNC)
snippet: Canada Nickel Company (TSXV: CNC) this week added its ninth deposit in the Timmins nickel district with an initial 176 million tonne Nesbitt resource grading 0.23% nickel (0.41 Mt contained nickel), while simultaneously delivering a 46% increase in Deloro's indicated resource to 0.3 Mt contained nickel across 118.7 million indicated tonnes — bringing the company's total Timmins district holding to 4.63 billion measured and indicated tonnes at 0.24% nickel. The scale of contiguous nickel sulphide mineralisation across nine separate deposits within one Ontario district is without close parallel in North American critical minerals development.

headline: CSIS ANALYST: CHINA'S RARE EARTH BAN BACKFIRED — 55 NATIONS UNITE AT RUBIO STATE DEPT MINISTERIAL TO BUILD ALTERNATIVE SUPPLY CHAINS
snippet: CSIS critical minerals security program head Gracelin Baskaran argues this week that China's decision to extend rare earth export restrictions to Japan, the EU, Australia, South Korea, and the US has paradoxically accelerated the international coordination that could permanently erode Beijing's grip on the sector. A February 2026 State Department ministerial convened by Secretary Rubio brought together 55 countries for what Baskaran called the largest gathering focused solely on critical minerals, producing coordinated investment commitments across mining, processing, and permanent magnet manufacturing — the downstream chokepoints China controls and that its export weaponization was meant to protect.

headline: FALCON METALS CLEARED TO DRILL OLSEN WELL — MAIDEN HOLES TARGET YILGARN GOLD 35 KM FROM GLENBURGH'S 10-12 Moz EXPLORATION TARGET (ASX: FAL)
snippet: Falcon Metals (ASX: FAL) received all regulatory approvals for its maiden drill program at the Olsen Well target within the Errabiddy Gold Project in Western Australia on July 27, marking the first-ever drill testing at a target 35 km southeast of Benz Mining's Glenburgh Gold Project — which holds a 10.1-to-12 million ounce gold exploration target along the northern Yilgarn Craton margin. Falcon can earn a 70% interest in exploration licence E09/2457 from West Coast Silver by completing the program, with early geological work confirming Olsen Well sits within the same structural corridor as the Glenburgh discovery.
